description: An AI-powered customer service platform and helpdesk with conversational ticketing, omnichannel inbox, and the Fin AI agent.
auth_notes: OAuth2 is used for public apps and integration access; personal access tokens or workspace access tokens (bearer tokens) are used for private apps.
credential_notes: Developers can sign up for a free development workspace and generate access tokens or set up OAuth apps via the Developer Hub without charge.
api_notes: Comprehensive REST API covering contacts, conversations, tickets, articles, help center, admins, data attributes, events, and Fin agent functions.
mcp_notes: Intercom's developer documentation mentions a docs MCP server capability or integrations, but no standard general MCP server for Intercom workspace data is published as an official vendor-backed agent tool yet.
rationale: Intercom provides a fully documented broad REST API and allows any developer to sign up for a free developer workspace and obtain credentials self-serve.

evidence.note: Intercom REST API reference and authentication models.
Sign up for free developer workspace and access the Developer Hub.
Detailed endpoint resources covering conversations, tickets, contacts, and help center.

open_questions: Whether an official vendor-supported MCP server for tool-calling agent runtimes is generally released or remains internal/docs-only.
